Most people think getting rich is about figuring out the how.

Kevin Trudeau says that's the number one mistake broke people make. They wait to even let themselves want a number until they know the technique first - the trading strategy, the real estate hack, the business plan.

Chase the how first and you get stuck asking "how, how, how" forever, with no answer. The people who actually build wealth do the opposite: decide exactly what they want, then let the how show up later.

Which one have you been doing - deciding what you want, or stalling on how to get it?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #wealthmindset #successhabits #mindsetshift #richmindset

Kevin Trudeau says you don't need to see the whole road to get rich - just the next 15 feet.

He compares chasing a goal to driving at night with no streetlights: pitch black, no moon, no stars. Your headlights only show 15 to 20 feet ahead. You keep driving anyway, because when you get there, you see further.

That's what he calls faith - not needing to know the entire "how" before you start. Demand to see the whole plan first, and you freeze. Analysis causes paralysis.

You don't need the full plan today. You need the next 15 feet, and the will to keep driving.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #successmindset #wealthmindset #moneymindset #faith

Kevin Trudeau was eating a sandwich at a shared table in a New York deli when a stranger sat down right beside him.

He recognized the man instantly: Bobby Singer, the card-counting guru from late-night TV infomercials. Bobby asked about Kevin's own memory-training business - then said something unexpected: record your workshop, sell it on TV.

Kevin said no, twice. His customers were business professionals - that audience doesn't buy from TV, he said. Bobby didn't back down. He offered to fund the whole production himself for just a royalty. Zero risk to Kevin.

Sometimes the person who sees your opportunity isn't you.

#kevintrudeau #success #wealthmindset #entrepreneur #moneymindset #mindset

A $35 difference in postage may have cost a man millions.

Kevin Trudeau had two separate strangers, on the exact same Saturday, independently tell him he should sell his memory course on TV. Both sent contracts: his friend Ed Beckley by Federal Express, for $35. Bobby Singer by regular mail.

Ed's contract landed first. Kevin signed with him - then had to call Bobby Singer to say he'd already been beaten to it. Bobby's words: "That $35 may have cost me millions."

Kevin went with Ed Beckley instead. They sold $450 million worth of courses on television.

How much is speed costing you right now?

#kevintrudeau #success #wealthmindset #moneymindset #businessowner #entrepreneur

Months earlier, Kevin Trudeau had told the universe he wanted $200,000 a week without having to work for it - laughing at himself, because he had no idea how that was even possible.

Then a Federal Express envelope showed up: his first royalty check from the TV infomercial deal he'd almost turned down twice. Inside was a check for "$250-something-thousand" - for one week.

He'd nearly forgotten he'd even made the request. The universe had answered it twice in one day, through two different strangers, months before that check ever arrived.

He wasn't chasing the how. He was just clear about the want.

What have you asked for and already forgotten you asked?
